content: Bootstrap patterns for fresh machines with a Nix flake (nixos-anywhere quickstart, treffynnon/nix-setup, MaxWolf-01/dotfiles, ELD/nix-system, return12.net, ahmedelgabri): NixOS path = nixos-install (local) or nix run nixos-anywhere (remote/unattended; needs disko disk-config, out of scope here); copy auto-generated hardware-configuration.nix into hosts/<name>/ then nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#host. Non-NixOS path = install Nix first (official installer script sh <(curl -L https://nixos.org/nix/install) --daemon or Determinate nix-installer), enable experimental-features 'nix-command flakes', then run HM standalone WITHOUT persistent install: nix run home-manager/master -- switch --flake .#host (STACK recommends release-26.05 pinned). Common repo-side bootstrap script pattern: scripts/setup.sh that (1) clones repo, (2) detects platform, (3) prompts/creates host dir if missing, (4) installs Nix if absent, (5) runs initial switch; treffynnon's setup.sh does exactly this. Flake apps (nix run .#setup) used by ahmedelgabri; Makefile/Justfile wrappers (hmswitch/nswitch aliases) avoid typing long nix commands (MaxWolf-01, cinque.dk Justfile).
